INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

2. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

6. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.

8. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

9. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

10. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
